snippet.title: Arctic Drive | Official Early Access Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Arctic Drive: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4009490/Arctic_Drive/

First-person survival road trip in a procedurally generated frozen wasteland. Drive and upgrade your off-road vehicle alone or with up to 3 friends, scavenge for fuel, food, and parts, and survive hunger, thirst, and sub-zero temperatures.
